title: Use a reference image and explicitly instruct Seedance to maintain the…
content:
Use a reference image and explicitly instruct Seedance to maintain the subject’s exact facial identity, hairstyle, facial features, and body proportions consistently throughout the entire video.

Write the prompt as a timestamped sequence (e.g., 0–5s, 5–12s, etc.) with specific actions and setting transitions to keep a 30-second video coherent and story-driven.

To get authentic handheld/home-video realism, explicitly request imperfections like natural camera shake, casual/awkward framing, occasional reframing, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping, subtle motion blur, rolling shutter, faded colors, soft contrast, and mild compression/sensor noise.

If you want a non-commercial “personal vlog” look, explicitly forbid cinematic/commercial aesthetics, stabilization, dramatic posing, artificial transitions, text overlays, logos, modern color grading, and identity/face changes.

Lock the environment by specifying what must be present and what must be absent (e.g., narrow residential alleys, laundry lines, overhead wires; no shops/ads/crowds/cafés) to prevent unwanted scene drift.

For more believable interactions, describe natural micro-behaviors and camera reactions (checking phone, adjusting hair, laughing naturally, camera reacts slightly late) rather than scripted acting.

If generating audio, constrain it to authentic location sound only and forbid music/narration/cinematic SFX; specify language for any speech (e.g., natural Korean only).

es.content:
Usa una imagen de referencia e indica explícitamente a Seedance que mantenga de forma consistente la identidad facial exacta del sujeto, el peinado, los rasgos faciales y las proporciones corporales a lo largo de todo el video.

Escribe el prompt como una secuencia con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0–5s, 5–12s, etc.) con acciones específicas y transiciones de escenario para mantener coherente y con narrativa un video de 30 segundos.

Para lograr un realismo auténtico de handheld/home-video, solicita explícitamente imperfecciones como sacudidas naturales de cámara, encuadre casual o torpe, reencuadres ocasionales, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping, desenfoque de movimiento sutil, rolling shutter, colores desvaídos, contraste suave y ruido leve de compresión/sensor.

Si quieres un aspecto de “personal vlog” no comercial, prohíbe explícitamente la estética cinematográfica/comercial, la estabilización, las poses dramáticas, las transiciones artificiales, los overlays de texto, los logos, el color grading moderno y los cambios de identidad/rostro.

Bloquea el entorno especificando qué debe estar presente y qué debe estar ausente (por ejemplo, callejones residenciales estrechos, cuerdas de ropa, cables aéreos; sin tiendas/anuncios/multitudes/cafeterías) para evitar que la escena se desvíe.

Para interacciones más creíbles, describe microcomportamientos naturales y reacciones de cámara (mirar el teléfono, acomodarse el cabello, reír de forma natural, la cámara reacciona un poco tarde) en lugar de actuación guionizada.

Si generas audio, limítalo únicamente a sonido auténtico de la ubicación y prohíbe música/narración/SFX cinematográficos; especifica el idioma de cualquier diálogo (por ejemplo, solo coreano natural).

Seedance 2.5

Prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic candid home-video sequence of a young Korean woman in her early 20s living an ordinary late morning in a quiet Korean residential neighborhood.

SUBJECT:
Young Korean woman, natural everyday appearance, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail with wispy bangs. Faded charcoal-grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light-wash jeans, black canvas sneakers, simple black cord necklace. Warm, relaxed personality. Keep her face, body, hairstyle, clothing, and appearance perfectly consistent throughout.

SETTING:
Authentic Korean residential neighborhood — narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, small terraces, potted plants, laundry lines, bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires and mature trees. Quiet, lived-in atmosphere. No shops, advertisements, crowds, cafés, or commercial activity.

VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic documentary home-video footage from an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. Imperfect handheld operation, natural camera shake, awkward framing, occasional reframing, autofocus hunting, slight lens breathing, exposure pumping between sunlight and shade, subtle motion blur, mild rolling shutter, faded colors, soft contrast, slight digital compression and sensor noise. No stabilization, no cinematic camera moves, no modern color grading. Everything must feel genuinely captured, not AI-generated.

TIMELINE:
00:00–00:05 — Outside her small house, she sits on a low concrete wall adjusting her messy ponytail. Wind moves loose strands of hair. She casually smiles while the camera struggles to lock focus.

00:05–00:10 — She walks into a narrow residential alley. A stray cat approaches. She crouches naturally, pets it and gently feeds it. Autofocus shifts imperfectly between her face and the cat.

00:10–00:15 — In a small front yard, she hangs laundry on a clothesline. Fabric moves naturally in the breeze while sunlight and cloud shadows subtly change the exposure.

00:15–00:20 — She sits on a quiet terrace with a simple ceramic coffee cup, casually watching the neighborhood and brushing loose hair behind her ear. Handheld side angle with natural camera drift.

00:20–00:25 — Close side profile. Someone off-camera casually greets her. She turns, smiles warmly, raises her hand and naturally says, “Annyeong.” The camera reacts slightly late.

00:25–00:30 — She walks slowly down a tree-lined residential lane holding her coffee. She notices the camera, gives a small genuine smile, then looks away and continues walking. The recording abruptly cuts to black mid-motion like an old camcorder being switched off.

AUDIO:
Only authentic location sound: birds, distant motorcycles, light wind, rustling leaves, faint neighborhood chatter, cat sounds, footsteps on concrete, laundry moving on the clothesline and subtle residential ambience. Natural Korean speech only. No music, narration, cinematic sound effects, or artificial sound design.

GOAL:
Make it feel like a forgotten personal home video from the early 2000s — intimate, spontaneous, imperfect, warm, mundane and deeply believable. Prioritize realistic human motion, natural facial expressions, physical interaction, environmental detail and consistent identity over cinematic beauty.
---

fr.content:
Utilisez une image de référence et demandez explicitement à Seedance de conserver de manière cohérente, tout au long de la vidéo, l’identité faciale exacte du sujet, sa coiffure, ses traits du visage et ses proportions corporelles.

Rédigez le prompt sous forme de séquence horodatée (par ex. 0–5 s, 5–12 s, etc.) avec des actions précises et des transitions de décor afin de garder une vidéo de 30 secondes cohérente et narrative.

Pour obtenir un réalisme authentique de type handheld/home-video, demandez explicitement des imperfections comme un léger tremblement naturel de la caméra, un cadrage décontracté ou maladroit, des recadrages occasionnels, des hésitations de l’autofocus, le lens breathing, des variations d’exposition, un léger motion blur, du rolling shutter, des couleurs délavées, un contraste doux et un léger bruit de compression/capteur.

Si vous voulez un rendu de “personal vlog” non commercial, interdisez explicitement les esthétiques cinématographiques/commerciales, la stabilisation, les poses dramatiques, les transitions artificielles, les incrustations de texte, les logos, le color grading moderne et les changements d’identité/de visage.

Verrouillez l’environnement en précisant ce qui doit être présent et ce qui doit être absent (par ex. ruelles résidentielles étroites, fils à linge, câbles aériens ; pas de boutiques/publicités/foules/cafés) afin d’éviter toute dérive indésirable de la scène.

Pour des interactions plus crédibles, décrivez des micro-comportements naturels et des réactions de caméra réalistes (vérifier son téléphone, remettre ses cheveux en place, rire naturellement, la caméra réagit légèrement en retard) plutôt qu’un jeu d’acteur trop scénarisé.

Si vous générez de l’audio, limitez-le strictement à un son d’ambiance authentique du lieu et interdisez la musique, la narration et les SFX cinématographiques ; précisez la langue de toute prise de parole (par ex. coréen naturel uniquement).

ja.content:
参照画像を使用し、Seedance に対して、被写体の正確な顔のアイデンティティ、髪型、顔の特徴、体のプロポーションを、動画全体を通して一貫して維持するよう明示的に指示してください。

プロンプトは、0〜5秒、5〜12秒のようなタイムスタンプ付きのシーケンスとして書き、具体的な動作と場面転換を入れて、30秒の動画が一貫性のあるストーリー性のあるものになるようにします。

本物らしい手持ち／ホームビデオのリアリズムを出すために、自然なカメラの揺れ、ラフで不自然なフレーミング、時折のリフレーミング、オートフォーカスの迷い、レンズブリージング、露出の揺れ、わずかなモーションブラー、ローリングシャッター、色あせた色味、柔らかいコントラスト、軽い圧縮ノイズ／センサーノイズといった不完全さを明示的に求めてください。

非商用の「パーソナル vlog」風にしたい場合は、cinematic／commercial な美学、手ブレ補正、ドラマチックなポーズ、人工的なトランジション、テキストオーバーレイ、ロゴ、現代的なカラーグレーディング、アイデンティティ／顔の変化を明確に禁止してください。

環境を固定するために、何が存在し、何が存在してはいけないかを指定してください（例：細い住宅路、物干し、頭上の電線；店、広告、人混み、カフェはなし）。これにより、意図しないシーンの逸脱を防げます。

より信じられるやり取りにするには、台本的な演技ではなく、自然な細かな仕草やカメラの反応（スマホを確認する、髪を直す、自然に笑う、カメラの反応が少し遅れる）を描写してください。

音声を生成する場合は、実際のロケーション音のみに制限し、音楽、ナレーション、cinematic な SFX を禁止してください。会話がある場合は、その言語も指定してください（例：自然な韓国語のみ）。

ko.content:
참조 이미지를 사용하고, Seedance가 영상 전체에서 피사체의 정확한 얼굴 정체성, 헤어스타일, 얼굴 특징, 신체 비율을 일관되게 유지하도록 명시적으로 지시하세요.

프롬프트는 30초 영상이 일관되고 스토리 중심으로 느껴지도록, 0–5초, 5–12초처럼 타임스탬프가 있는 시퀀스 형식으로 작성하고, 각 구간마다 구체적인 행동과 배경 전환을 넣으세요.

진짜 같은 핸드헬드/홈비디오 리얼리즘을 얻으려면, 자연스러운 카메라 흔들림, 다소 캐주얼하거나 어색한 구도, 가끔의 재구도, 오토포커스 헌팅, 렌즈 브리딩, 노출 펌핑, 미세한 모션 블러, 롤링 셔터, 바랜 색감, 부드러운 대비, 약한 압축/센서 노이즈 같은 불완전함을 명시적으로 요청하세요.

비상업적인 “개인 브이로그” 느낌을 원한다면, 시네마틱/상업적 미학, 안정화, 드라마틱한 포즈, 인위적인 전환, 텍스트 오버레이, 로고, 현대적인 컬러 그레이딩, 정체성/얼굴 변화는 명시적으로 금지하세요.

환경은 반드시 있어야 할 것과 없어야 할 것을 구체적으로 지정해 고정하세요(예: 좁은 주거 골목, 빨랫줄, 전선, 전봇대; 상점/광고/군중/카페 없음) — 그래야 원치 않는 장면 이탈을 막을 수 있습니다.

더 믿을 만한 상호작용을 위해서는, 대본처럼 짜인 연기보다 자연스러운 미세 행동과 카메라 반응(휴대폰 확인, 머리 정리, 자연스럽게 웃기, 카메라가 약간 늦게 반응 등)을 묘사하세요.

오디오를 생성한다면, 실제 현장음만 사용하도록 제한하고 음악/내레이션/시네마틱 SFX는 금지하세요. 대사가 있다면 언어도 지정하세요(예: 자연스러운 한국어만).
